data.name: AlHashim
data.long_meaning: AlHashim is a name of Arabic origin, derived from the root word Hashim. It is a name of great historical significance in Islam, as Hashim was the name of the ancestor of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) through his uncle, Imam Ali (AS). The name AlHashim signifies a person who is a descendant of Hashim and carries the noble legacy and virtues of his ancestry.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrying the legacy and virtues of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and Imam Ali (AS)
